records.description: Don't get carried away by your success. Get carried away by your ripptor.
records.name: Ripp-Ripp Hooray!

records.description: You could be the author of the magnum opus 'How to Summon the Ultimate Beast from the Infernal Depths, Volume I'. Or, if your mind and heart are pure, you rather summon beings to help others. Or maybe just a little cat to have someone to cuddle.
records.name: Ritualist

records.description: You have defeated the glooth bomb and chopped down a lot of metal monsters on your way.
records.name: Robo Chop

records.description: Sleeping - you do it with style. You're chilling in your hammock, listening to the sound of the birds and crickets as you slowly drift away into the realm of dreams.
records.name: Rock Me to Sleep

records.description: Either you are not a fast learner or you find some pleasure in setting yourself on fire. Or you're just looking for a fancy title. In any case, you should know that passing gas during your little donkey experiments is not recommended.
records.name: Rocket in Pocket

records.description: Music just comes to you naturally. You feel comfortable on any stage, at any time, and secretly hope that someday you will be able to defeat your foes by playing music only. Rock on!
records.name: Rockstar

records.description: Up and down and up and down... and then the big looping! Wait - they don't build loopings in Kazordoon. But ore wagon rides are still fun!
records.name: Rollercoaster

records.description: You've descended into the swampy depths of Deathbine's lair and made quick work of it.
records.name: Rootless Behaviour

records.description: For some it can't be hazardous enough.
records.name: Royalty of Hazard

records.description: As an avid collector you managed to complete a full set of rubber ducks during the Great Expedition and traded it for a unique noble bath tub! Given you will acquire even more ducks in the future, this is the proper way to launch them!
records.name: Rubber Ducking

records.description: You have defeated the tremor worm - and wonder what kind of fish you'd be able to catch with such a bait.
records.name: Rumble in the Plant

records.description: You don't just have a permission to ride a rift runner, you literally went through hell and earned it!
records.name: Running the Rift

records.description: You've touched all thrones of the Ruthless Seven and absorbed some of their evil spirit. It may have changed you forever.
records.name: Ruthless

records.description: Don't worry, no one will be able to take it from you. Probably.
records.name: Safely Stored Away

records.description: Your outstanding work towards the launch of the Great Expedition turned out well for you. You decided it's time to take a break and the Landsailer for a spin! May you always have wind in your sails and a hand-width of even ground under your wheels!
records.name: Sail Away!

records.description: Christmas is your favourite time of the year, and boy, do you love presents. Buy some nice things for your friends, hide them away until - well, until you decide to actually unwrap them rather yourself.
records.name: Santa's Li'l Helper

records.description: The Muggy Plains are a dangerous place, often raided by dragons. But that was your luck: thus you found this scaly little guy.
records.name: Scales and Tail

records.description: A mighty blaze went out today. It's Flameborn's turn to wait for his rebirth in the eternal cycle of life and death.
records.name: Scorched Flames

records.description: You are a master of the nether sea and have traveled with the ghost captain so many times that you know his ship and the perils of the nether sea inside out. You laugh in the face of death and may return as a ghost pirate yourself in the afterlife!
records.name: Scourge of Death

records.description: You took the heat and defeated the Ancient Spawn of Morgathla!
records.name: Scourge of Scarabs

records.description: You put out the Spirit of Fire's flames in the arena of Svargrond. Arena fights are for you - fair, square, with simple rules and one-on-one battles.
records.name: Scrapper

records.description: Granted, you didn't carve those lifelike animal figurines yourself. But helping a medusa to find proper objects and even watching her using her petrifying gaze is almost as rewarding.
records.name: Sculptor Apprentice

records.description: Not even the hostile underwater environment stops you from doing your duty for the Explorer Society. Scouting the Quara realm is a piece of cake for you.
records.name: Sea Scout

records.description: Adventure is your middle name. You spent much time in dangerous lands and have seen things others only dream of. You know your way around in Tibia - you are a seasoned adventurer now. And your journey has only just begun!
records.name: Seasoned Adventurer

records.description: Pack your spy gear and get ready for some dangerous missions in service of a secret agency. You've shown you want to - but can you really do it? Time will tell.
records.name: Secret Agent

records.description: You have fully unlocked 100 medium monsters in the cyclopedia.
records.name: Serious Contender

records.description: You are now the public archenemy of the Shaburak, prince slayer.
records.name: Shaburak Nemesis

records.description: Just everyone will be crazy about you if you are wearing this formal dress. They will come running, promise!
records.name: Sharp Dressed

records.description: Improved eyesight, arrows and bolts flying at the speed of light and pinning your enemies with extra damage. All in a little bottle. No consumption of carrots required. For further questions consult your healer or potion dealer.
records.name: Sharpshooter

records.description: You found a hundred beautiful pearls in large sea shells. By now that necklace should be finished - and hopefully you didn't get your fingers squeezed too often during the process.
records.name: Shell Seeker

records.description: Equipped with the shell of a tortoise and claws of a lobster this insect like companion will help you through every hardship.
records.name: Shell We Take a Ride

records.description: You’ve probably never gotten seasick in your life — you love spending your free time on the ocean and covered quite a lot of miles with ships. Aren’t you glad you didn’t have to swim all that?
records.name: Ship's Kobold

records.description: You've found the oriental traveller Yasir and were able to trade with him - even if you didn't really understand his language.
records.name: Si, Ariki!

records.description: Awww. Your very own little goldfish friend - he's cute, he's shiny and he can't complain should you forget to feed him. He'll definitely brighten up your day!
records.name: Silent Pet

records.description: Swift and silent, the jaracal now runs at your side.
records.name: Six Steps Ahead

records.description: You have fully unlocked 10 hard monsters in the cyclopedia.
records.name: Skilled Hunter

records.description: You always carry your obsidian knife with you and won't hesitate to use it. You've skinned countless little - and bigger - critters and yeah: they usually don't get any more beautiful on the inside. It's rather blood and gore and all that...
records.name: Skin-Deep

records.description: Wearing the insignia and dark robes of the Brotherhood of Bones you roam the lands spreading fear and pain, creating new soldiers for the necromantic army which is about to rise soon. Hail the Brotherhood.
records.name: Skull and Bones

records.description: Souls are like butterflies. The black soul of a living weapon yearning to strike lies shattered beneath your feet.
records.name: Slayer of Anmothra

records.description: Power lies in the will of her who commands it. You fought it with full force - and were stronger.
records.name: Slayer of Chikhaton

records.description: Few things equal the wild fury of a trapped and riven creature. You were a worthy opponent.
records.name: Slayer of Irahsae

records.description: Blind hatred took physical form, violently rebelling against the injustice it was born into. You were not able to bring justice - but at least temporary peace.
records.name: Slayer of Phrodomo

records.description: The forbidden knowledge of aeons was never meant to invade this world. You silenced its voice before it could be made heard.
records.name: Slayer of Teneshpar

records.description: You know your way, in dream and waking. And how to make tea that transcends the boundaries of conscience.
records.name: Sleepwalking

records.description: Okay, let's face it - as long as you believe it could potentially lead you to the biggest treasure ever, you won't let go of that map, however fishy it might look. There must be a secret behind all of this!
records.name: Slim Chance

records.description: With the assistance of your friendly little helper, you gobbled more than 500 chunks of slime. Well done, Slimer.
records.name: Slimer

records.description: Drugging a snail can have some beneficial side effects. You're now the proud owner of a snarling, speed-crazy slug.  Maybe it'll purr if you stroke it. Anyway, life should be one slick ride from now on.
records.name: Slugging Around

records.description: Smart you indeed. The gods almost gave up hope that anyone would ever figure THAT one out. They smile on you proudly now.
records.name: Smart Thinking

records.description: By restoring the Everhungry Altar, you charmed the Fire-Feathered Sea Serpent back into its fitful sleep, twenty miles beneath the sea.
records.name: Snake Charmer

records.description: Mysterious nagas, a vibrant jungle and a sinking island - you really know every corner of Marapur now.
records.name: Snake Pit

records.description: Hopping, hopping through the snow - that's the funnest way to go! Making footprints in a flurry - it's more fun the more you hurry! Licking icicles all day - Winter, never go away!
records.name: Snowbunny

records.description: You have braved the searing heat in the tunnels deep below Kazordoon and vanquished the Brainstealer. The voices inside your head are finally silenced.
records.name: Some Like It Hot

records.description: That was NOT a giant spider. There's some witchcraft at work here.
records.name: Someone's Bored

records.description: By the gods! What was that?
records.name: Something's in There

records.description: You've extinguished the Sulphur Scuttler's gas clouds and made the air in his cave a little better... at least for a while.
records.name: Something Smells

records.description: The Soulpit resonates as the spirit of your final foe shatters under your might.
records.name: Soul Crusher

records.description: You were burdened with all this soul crushing negativity and still beat Malice, Hatred, Spite, Cruelty and Greed just to help one repentant soul. But as the saying goes: No soul is left behind!
records.name: Soul Mender

records.description: Ribstride is striding no more. He had quite a few ribs to spare though.
records.name: Spareribs for Dinner

records.description: You have sailed the nether seas with the Ghost Captain several times. The dangers of the nether have become familiar to you and unexperienced travelers turn to you for advice.
records.name: Spectral Traveller

records.description: You checked out a strange temple deep in the jungles of Tiquanda. Spectulus was right, it was indeed overrun by strange fish-men you now call Deathlings.
records.name: Spectulation

records.description: Seems like this spider has got a sweet tooth. As a result, eight hairy legs are now at your disposal to crawl and weave at your whim, and strike fear into the hearts of men.
records.name: Spin-Off

records.description: You travelled the depths of this very world. You entered the blackness of the deep sea to conquer the realm of the Deeplings. May this suit remind you of the strange beauty below.
records.name: Spolium Profundis

records.description: After hunting for the correct mushrooms and their spores you're starting to feel like a mushroom yourself. A few times more and you might start thinking like a mushroom, who knows?
records.name: Spore Hunter

records.description: Modifying Brewmaster Bhaan's Raubritter Lager with a hint of Night Harpy, you received a potent remedy against their vicious attacks. Drinking so much of it however, you wonder what other side effects it has as you stare at the moon... mesmerised...
records.name: Stagmeister

records.description: You have spent 70.000.000 gold overall to fund the Great Expedition. Congratulations for helping to make this dream come true!
records.name: Stakeholder

records.description: By many it is considered a myth like the Yeti. But you came, saw and tamed it. Now you're the proud rider of a midnight panther, black as a starless night.
records.name: Starless Night

records.description: Travelling with the dwarven steamboats through the underground rivers is your preferred way of crossing the lands. No pesky seagulls, and good beer on board!
records.name: Steampunked

records.description: Champion of the wildlands, a swift strider among the creatures of the wild. The elegant nature of the gallop, this envoy of speed has mastered, indicates the precise understanding of its terrain and environment.
records.name: Steppe Elegance

records.description: This time you knocked out the big one.
records.name: Stepped on a Big Toe

records.description: You severely disrupted the digestion of the hive. The hive should for sure see a doctor. It seems you proved to be more than it can swallow.
records.name: Stomach Ulcer

records.description: Only its rider can love this abomination of a mount.
records.name: Strangest Thing

records.description: Strong fortresses, sprawling woods and ivory towers - you really know every corner of Edron now.
records.name: Stronghold of Edron

records.description: A drop of oil and you're good to go. This unique mount will roll merrily in and out of any strange place you want to visit. If you see no exit, you probably ended up in a circus ring. Ah well, the show must go on!
records.name: Stuntman

records.description: Ring-a-ding! You have visited the golem workshop and lent a hand in repairing them. To know those golems are safe is worth all the bruises, isn't it?
records.name: Substitute Tinker

records.description: You made sure that the balance of sun and sea is preserved in Kilmaresh. The Golden City of Issavi won't forget your favour.
records.name: Sun and Sea

records.description: Fortune tellers and horoscopes guide you through your life. And you probably wouldn't dare going on a big game hunt without your trusty voodoo skull giving you his approval for the day.
records.name: Superstitious

records.description: The need for supplies often decides over loss or victory. Your tireless efforts to resupply the resources keeps the war against the hive going.
records.name: Supplier

records.description: A war is won by those who have the best supply of troops. The hive's troops have been dealt a significant blow by your actions. You interrupted the hive's replenishment of troops lastingly and severely.
records.name: Suppressor

records.description: By cleverly using a leech to cool that raging bull's blood, you managed not to get swamped or trampled in a water buffalo stampede. The creature is now docile and follows your every command.
records.name: Swamp Beast

records.description: Ye be a gentleman o' fortune, fightin' and carousin' on the high seas, out fer booty and lassies! Ye no be answerin' to no man or blasted monarchy and yer life ain't fer the lily-livered. Aye, matey!
records.name: Swashbuckler

records.description: The famous 'Ode to a Molten Chocolate Cake' was probably written by you. Spending a rainy afternoon in front of the chimney, wrapped in a blanket while indulging in cocoa delights sounds just like something you'd do. Enjoy!
records.name: Sweet Tooth

records.description: Stealth kills and backstabbing are your specialty. Your numerous victims are usually unaware of their imminent death, which you bring to them silently and swiftly. Everything is permitted.
records.name: Swift Death

records.description: You're a lord or lady of the dance - and not afraid to use your skills to impress tribal gods. One step to the left, one jump to the right, twist and shout!
records.name: Talented Dancer

records.description: Helping a poor, stupid goblin to feed his starving children and wifes feels good ... if you'd only get rid of the strange feeling that you're missing something.
records.name: Task Manager

records.description: You don't just read the bulletin board, you live on it.
records.name: Taskaholic

records.description: Having hunted and bested them all, you live for the thrill of the hunt!
records.name: Taskmaster

records.description: You don't consider yourself too good to do the dirty work while someone else might win the laurels for killing Devovorga. They couldn't do it without you!
records.name: Teamplayer

records.description: On the shoulders of demons, you tore through veils of venomous corruption. Demonic essences made you an unstoppable force but take care to also foster your human side.
records.name: Tear the Toxic Veil

records.description: Your map is your friend — always in your back pocket and covered with countless marks of interesting and useful locations. One could say that you might be lost without it — but luckily there's no way to take it from you.
records.name: Territorial

records.description: And anyone claiming otherwise is a liar.
records.name: The Cake's the Truth

records.description: You opposed man-eating ogres and clumys clomps. You grappled with hungry chieftains, desperate goblins and angry spirits. So you truly overcame the wild vastness of Krailos.
records.name: The Call of the Wild

records.description: Uhm... who's that person who you just woke up beside? Broken cocktail glasses on the floor, flowers all over the room, and why the heck are you wearing a ring? Yesterday must have been a long, weird day...
records.name: The Day After

records.description: As the killer of Leviathan, the giant sea serpent, his underwater kingdom is now under your reign.
records.name: The Drowned Sea God

records.description: Mythical creatures, forgotten catacombs and the Golden City - you really know every corner of Kilmaresh now.
records.name: The Empire's Glory

records.description: The first step to greatness has been done.
records.name: The First of Many

records.description: Surely, this will prove useful in the future... right?
records.name: The Forbidden Build

records.description: It seems the gates to the underworld have to remain unprotected for a while. Kerberos, the mighty hellhound, lost his head. All three of them.
